channel.title: Petre Radu Cătălin - Blog
channel.description: Insights from Petre Radu Cătălin - technical write-ups on offensive security, penetration testing, cloud threats, and AI security.

item.title: AI Security: Testing LLMs for Prompt Injection and Data Exfiltration
item.description: A field guide to how I evaluate AI systems offensively - prompt injection, indirect injection through retrieved content, and the data-exfiltration bugs that leak what LLMs are told through their own outputs.
item.author: Petre Radu Cătălin

item.title: Cloud Misconfigurations That Pentesters Love to Exploit
item.description: The top cloud misconfigurations I encounter on real engagements - S3 buckets, over-permissive roles, exposed credentials, and public snapshots - and how to find them before the attackers do.
item.author: Petre Radu Cătălin

item.title: From Web App to Domain Admin: A Red Team Playbook
item.description: A practical, phase-by-phase breakdown of how a single web application flaw can be chained into full Active Directory compromise - and the detection gaps that let it happen.
item.author: Petre Radu Cătălin
